headline: Congress named the Necedah, Wisconsin, post office building after Sergeant Kenneth E. Murphy.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 603 West 3rd Street in Necedah, Wisconsin, as the Sergeant Kenneth E. Murphy Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building and does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the designation took effect on that date.
